items.desc: An agent skill that draws animated icons in one consistent style, for Claude Code, Codex and other coding agents. Comes with 2,600+ open-source icons for React, Vue and SVG, and a website to browse them.
Audit pháp lý website theo luật Việt Nam (BVDLCN 91/2025, TMĐT 122/2025, ANM 116/2025, AI 134/2025) cho Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, Windsurf, Cline
CrommaCode — the gamified IDE for coding agents. Watch Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor CLI or OpenCode work as a game, and send a swarm of worker agents. Free for macOS, Windows and Linux.
